description: This is a Java source file defining the UspsServices class, which provides various static methods for interacting with USPS web services API. The functionalities include rate inquiries (domestic and international), tracking, address validation, city/state lookup, service standards, and delivery confirmation, among others. It orchestrates the creation of XML requests, sending them, and parsing responses to fulfill USPS-related operations in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UspsServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for USPS API interactions including rate inquiries, tracking, address validation, and other USPS web services.
